title: Product of Boolean monomials
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ and $T$ be finite sets of coordinates in $
{0,1}$, and let $x$ be a function from $
{0,1}$ to the field $ br/2 br$. The product of the monomials indexed by $S$ and $T$, evaluated at $x$, equals the monomial indexed by $S\cup T$, evaluated at $x$.
